disclaimer_title: This is not an official app
disclaimer_long: This app is not made by, and is not affiliated with, the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (MIT), the Motorizzazione Civile or any government body. The true/false statements are taken from the official list for licence B published by the Ministry on the Portale dell'Automobilista. Translations, explanations and the driving mode were written for this app and may contain mistakes: when in doubt, follow the official Italian text and your driving school.

ed_1: A valid identity document (passport, ID card or residence permit)
ed_2: Confirm date, time and Motorizzazione office with your driving school
ed_3: Glasses or contact lenses, if your medical certificate requires them
ed_5: Phone off: phones and notes are not allowed in the exam room
ed_6: Do one last exam simulation the day before
ed_7: Sleep well and eat something before the exam
ed_rule_tries: If you fail, you can retry: at most 2 attempts within 6 months of the application, at least 1 month apart (ask your driving school)
ed_rule_foglio: After passing you get the "foglio rosa" (learner permit), valid 12 months, with 3 attempts at the driving test
